findings: At 0x618c, the critical-error routine subtracts 19, indexes the 21-word table at runtime offset 0x155b, dereferences its result, and passes the resulting message pointer to the print routine.
The table values address the pointer fields of class 6 entries 219 through 239, providing the missing second level of indirection.
The input routine compares characters through the relocated class 6 pointer fields for No and Yes.
The command reload error path reads the class 6 pointers for IDs 118 and 119 and prints both; the execution-error path reads the pointer for ID 126.
limitations: Runtime offsets assume the segment layout and successful resource loading described in the separate fixup evidence.
Full routine source, all consumers and final binary link remain unverified.
